Common questions

Can a retractable awning stay out in the rain?

Light rain is usually fine for short periods if the awning is pitched to shed water. Retract it in heavy rain, wind, and storms.

Manual or motorized?

Both exist. Motorized awnings are easier to use daily and can add sensors. We'll recommend based on size and how often you'll use it.

How far can an awning extend?

It depends on the model and the wall it mounts to. We'll measure and show you how much shade the space can get.
